notes: Modified cash basis city audit (FYE 9/30/2022), handled like FY2023. Governmental lines from the governmental funds statement Total column (p5-6); combined lines split from the fund schedules: Taxes 482,346 (General p16, Street p19, Debt Service p24, TIF p28), State revenues 331,922 (General, Street, Debt Service, TIF), Charges for services 28,923 (park and pool, Street rentals, Library fees), Other 964,019 (General misc incl. rentals, Street other, LB 840 loan payments, Debt Service PPD lease, nonmajor Other per p31). Fund balances (2,501,400 -> 2,308,404) in the *_fund_balance fields; cash fields use the printed cash asset lines of the governmental funds statement (all assets are cash; 2021 Total column for beginning, p4). Transfers General out 75,000 -> Street 30,000 and Sewer 20,000 / Water 25,000 (business transfers_net 45,000). Debt Service issuance of debt 545,000 -> debt_proceeds; 'Debt service principal refinanced' (525,000) -> other_financing. Business-type from the modified cash proprietary statement (p9-10), measure net position (includes capital assets); business disbursements total = Statement of Activities business-type expenditures 814,766 (p2). Proprietary cash flow statements (p11-12, p34-35) not recorded (proprietary null as in later years). Detail: General Fund budget-and-actual schedule (p16-18) used; the General Fund by-department schedule (p29-30) and the combined all-funds budgetary schedule (p13-15) are not recorded to avoid double counting; nonmajor combining schedule (p31) duplicates the individual fund schedules (p21-28) and is skipped; ARPA schedule has no expenditures. Business-type detail from the supplementary accrual-basis proprietary statement (p32-33) by fund; the Sewer and Water fund statements (p36-37) duplicate their columns (Water folds tower painting 1,150 into repairs 3,263) and are skipped; accrual figures differ from the modified cash statements (accrual ending net position 3,032,591). Budget lines with no actual (General state grants 15,000; Street federal grants 20,755 and issuance of debt 433,195; Library state aid 1,085; LB 840 capital outlay 1,000 and reappropriation 350,000; CDBG other local 42,000; Debt Service reappropriation 250,000) not recorded. Capital outlay detail_category 'not itemized' (no object printed); Community building capital outlay labelled plain 'Capital Outlay' (no function printed for that heading). Read pages 1-37 of 37
